Case No.-540 Year-2020 Thana- Gopalganj Town Dis Gopalganj ====================================================== R K International Through Its Proprietor Kabir Singh ... ... Petitioner Versus The State Of Bihar Through The Additional Chief Sect. Dept. Of Home (Police) Govt. Of Bihar, ... ... Respondents ====================================================== With Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No. 408 of 2020 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-224 Year-2020 Thana- Manjhagarh District- ====================================================== Brahma Trading Company Through Its Proprietor Brahma Nanda Puri, ... ... Petitioner Versus The State Of Bihar Through The Additional Chief Sect. Dept. Of Home(Police), Govt. Of Bihar, Patna ... ... Respondents ====================================================== Appearance : (In Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No. 407 of 2020) For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Prabhat Ranjan, Advocate
texts.facts: Officer has been placed on the record with a copy of the Food Analyst report. According to the analysis report Magnesium Patna High Court CR. WJC No.407 of 2020(8) dt.26-03-2021 Carbonate (an anticaking agent) has been found in the given sample of the Pan Masala use of which is restricted in the said commodity. Reference in this regard has been made to the Regulation 3.1.7 of Chapter of the F.S.S. (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulation 2011 and hence it has been held unsafe within the scope of Section 3(i)(zz) (iii)(v) of the FSS Act, 2006. The second supplementary counter affidavit has also been filed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 40/2020. Perusal of the affidavit sworn by the respondent no. 5 shows that he has taken certain action including that of initiation of a departmental proceeding against the police officers who have been prima-facie found acting negligently.
